Please evaluate the moderation using the following scale (In the event that you are not able to respond to a question, please indicate NA):
Requirements Not Met | 1
Requirements Met | 2
Requirements Exceeded | 3
ACCREDITATION PROCESS
To what extent was the Accreditation plan made clear to you as the provider?
Was the plan in accordance with your company’s QMS policy and procedure?
Did the evaluator provide adequate communication using appropriate techniques?
Were the appropriate parties informed of the Accreditation exercise?
Was the selected Accreditation technique appropriate to deal with the types of evidence gathered?
To what extent did the tools used by the evaluator facilitate the purpose of the Accreditation exercise?
Was the Accreditation conducted in accordance with the Accreditation plan?
To what extent do you believe the internal Accreditation system is aligned to the external Accreditation process?
MODERATOR
Did the evaluator demonstrate competence within the field of the Accreditation exercise?
During the site visit, did the evaluator demonstrate good interpersonal skills?
Do you believe the evaluator was able to be objective?
Did the evaluator provide you as the provider with additional opportunities to clarify evidence gathered?
Do you agree that the evaluator reached the correct Accreditation decision?
Was the evaluator open to suggestions of how their moderation process can be improved?
How well did the evaluator maintain confidentiality with regards to the assessment?
ADVICE AND SUPPORT
To what extent did you as the provider agree with the evaluator findings on how well you upheld the assessment principles?
To what extent do you believe the evaluator advice will promote quality in accordance with good assessment procedures?
To what degree will the evaluator advice enhance the formulation of a good Quality Management System within your company?
To what extent do you believe changes will be implemented within your company due to the change in the processes and tools used for accreditation?
Was advice and support coherently documented in the report and during the process?
To what extent has this prompted you as provider to adapt your overall training processes?
Were the accreditation outcomes communicated to the appropriate parties?

sections.heading: Additional Comments and Suggestions: Specifically, what would you recommend to the moderator to improve the moderation process?
sections.text:
Many Thanks for your time and valuable feedback.
